minor.issue: ws_url, sip_uri, sip_domain, stun_url all rely on os.environ vars (PBX_WS_URL, PBX_SIP_DOMAIN, PBX_STUN_URL); only sip_domain + stun_url have fallback defaults. ws_url defaults to empty string — softphone will silently fail to register in any pod where PBX_WS_URL is not set (the JsSIP useEffect early-returns on falsy ws_url, so reg-state stays 'idle' rather than 'registering' or 'failed'). Consider returning a clearer error/banner when ws_url is empty so admins know to configure it.

integration_issues.issue: reg-state remains 'idle' in preview because backend returns ws_url=''; the useEffect skips the JsSIP boot, never transitioning to 'registering' or 'failed'. UI shows the 'Connecting to PBX…' helper only for 'registering'/'failed'/'disconnected', so an 'idle' state with empty ws_url has no user-facing hint. Suggest a banner when config exists but ws_url is empty.

Optional: surface a UI hint when /me/softphone returns config but ws_url is empty so admins know PBX_WS_URL must be set on the appliance side.
Optional: when register=true & username='', return validation error consistently — already done by /trunks POST (verified).
